node.title: DLI terminal weight-5 relations excluded on the first 64 ambient split primes
node.statement: For q=k*2^41+1, the first 64 prime rows in increasing positive k occur over 3<=k<=996. Exact pair/triple meet-in-the-middle replay checks all 130,560 legal pairs and 22,108,160 legal triples per row and finds no reduced signed weight-5 relation. Proper-divisor witnesses cover the 932 intervening composite values, and direct Pocklington certificates prove all 64 prime rows. This is finite evidence only: the remaining ambient weight-5 rows, weight 6, and WCL-ZONE remain open.
